command: ninja -C build-vk rhi_swapchain_bench && ./build-vk/rhi_swapchain_bench.exe receipt.json (640x480 clear-color + present, 600 frames, vsync off; Debug build with VK validation messenger default-on)
runner: local workstation (Windows 11, RTX 4060 Laptop hybrid GPU, otherwise idle); Vulkan baseline for the D3D12 plan-F benchmark receipt. Median of 6 runs 1766.5 fps (1420.10..1841.10); this run is the median-side representative used as the 90%-threshold denominator. Full engine demo scene not used: engine_demo on D3D12 is fail-closed at rhi_device_create_compiled (plan E Task 2; HLSL allowlist blit;myui cannot cover the full renderer shader set), so the comparable workload is the rhi_swapchain_bench harness on both backends.
